"""Public API for the glom package.

This module re-exports the most commonly used classes and functions
from :mod:`glom.core`, :mod:`glom.reduction`, and :mod:`glom.mutation`.

The original upstream ``__init__`` contained a number of imports that
were duplicated or mis-indented during a previous edit.  The current
implementation restores a clean, minimal, and well-documented public
API.

The list of re-exported names is intentionally kept in sync with the
tests and with the documentation.
"""

# Core glom functionality
from glom.core import (
    glom,
    register,
    Glommer,
    Call,
    Spec,
    OMIT,  # backwards compat
    SKIP,
    STOP,
    Check,
    Path,
    Literal,
    Coalesce,
    Inspect,
    GlomError,
    CheckError,
    PathAccessError,
    CoalesceError,
    UnregisteredTarget,
    T,
    S,
    Auto,
    Fill,
    Iter,
    Let,
    ROOT,
    Invoke,
)

# Reduction helpers
from glom.reduction import Sum, Fold, Flatten, flatten, FoldError, Merge, merge

# Mutation helpers
from glom.mutation import Assign, assign, PathAssignError

__all__ = [
    "glom",
    "register",
    "Glommer",
    "Call",
    "Spec",
    "OMIT",
    "SKIP",
    "STOP",
    "Check",
    "Path",
    "Literal",
    "Coalesce",
    "Inspect",
    "GlomError",
    "CheckError",
    "PathAccessError",
    "CoalesceError",
    "UnregisteredTarget",
    "T",
    "S",
    "Auto",
    "Fill",
    "Iter",
    "Let",
    "ROOT",
    "Invoke",
    "Sum",
    "Fold",
    "Flatten",
    "flatten",
    "FoldError",
    "Merge",
    "merge",
    "Assign",
    "assign",
    "PathAssignError",
]
